Vengeance's Mark picks its target from the damage everyone deals, so part of it lives in the World Easy Effects script, next to the system's own world rules (Defeated, Stagger, Panic).

Install once per world

  1. Import the items you want from the Boi's Homebrew compendium, or drag them straight onto gear.
  2. Open the Easy Effects editor for the world script.
  3. Paste the script below under what is already there. Keep the system's default lines.
  4. Save.

The setting

The line set flag "vengeance_mode" on combat to 3; near the top picks how the mark moves:

  • 1: re-pick every round; the mark stays put if nobody hurt your side.
  • 2: re-pick every round; the mark is removed if nobody hurt your side.
  • 3 (default): sticky; it stays until the marked creature is Defeated or leaves combat, then moves to the next highest candidate.

How it decides

  • Only HP lost to attacks counts. Damage to the Marked For Vengeance owner counts too.
  • The marked creature comes from the other side; ties go to whoever is first in the combat order.
  • It only runs in a combat where someone has Marked For Vengeance on an active augment.
  • Chains Of Loyalty asks the player which ally gets the Strength and Endurance.
